citation.source: 7 CFR 210.10 — the five reimbursable-meal food components are fruits, vegetables, grains, meats/meat alternates, and fluid milk; oils/fats are not listed as a creditable component (they are addressed only via the meal pattern's separate saturated-fat/calorie nutrition standards, not credited toward any food-group requirement).
citation.note: Directly confirmed against the regulation text (law.cornell.edu's eCFR mirror, 2026-08-19): 'The regulation does not list oils or fats as creditable meal components.'
